name: Brasswind Siren Brass
description: A resonant brass alloy tuned to gale-hammer frequencies.
specialEffects: Used in weighted mauls, acoustic housings, and windbound metalwork.

steps: Refine raw stock for Brasswind Siren Brass under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Brasswind Refinery protocol before storage.
